content: विग्रह् €9 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To hold or seize, catch hold of; विजगृहे तिसृणां जयिनं पुराम् <ls>Ki. 18. 12</ls>. .²2 To quarrel, fight, contend; विगृह्य चक्रे नमुचिद्विषा बली य इत्थमस्वास्थ्यमहर्दिवं दिवः <ls>Śi. 1. 51</ls>; <ls>Bk. 6. 86</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">17. 23</ls>; <ls>Ki. 14. 24</ls>. .²3 To divide into parts, separate (into constituent members). .²4 To dissolve, analyse, resolve in general. .²5 To receive, welcome (as a guest). .²6 To perceive, observe. .²7 To stretch or spread out.
